title: Acoustic representations of different dimensions of the gendered self. An analysis of nonbinary and cisgender speakers
why_promising: Primary semi-spontaneous German speech from 52 analyzed speakers (17 cis female, 17 cis male, 18 nonbinary) with broad production acoustics spanning fundamental-frequency properties, vowel formants/vowel-space measures, sibilant spectral properties, and voice-quality measures. The journal page exposes four supplementary files, making file-level recovery plausible.
